outcome: Risk of cesarean delivery after induction of labor (IOL) in term pregnancies with COOK® Cervical Ripening Balloon (CCRB) treatment
cohort: 415 pregnant women requiring IOL from January 2018 to October 2022
finding: Parity, modified Bishop score at induction, and artificial rupture of membranes were identified as predictors of cesarean delivery after IOL in term pregnancies with CCRB treatment.
